prose.subject: Friendly Payment Reminder: Invoice INV-83787 from Marlow Print
prose.body:
Hi Eastgate Clinics team,

Hope you are having a great week! This is just a gentle reminder from us at Marlow Print regarding invoice INV-83787, which is currently outstanding in the amount of 8197.04 USDC. We know things get busy, so we wanted to nudge the file to the top of your inbox.

To settle this balance, please send the funds to our standard wallet address: 0x3a2da437d40faf792bc6b9d5d31a640a058b8877. This is the same address we use for all our routine transactions, so you can feel confident sending it there. Once the transfer goes through, our system will automatically update your account status, and you will receive a confirmation receipt shortly after.

If you have already sent the payment, please ignore this email or mark it as read. If you have any questions about the invoice details or need a copy of the original document sent to you, just reply to this email and our billing team will be happy to help.

Thank you for your continued partnership with Marlow Print. We really appreciate your business!

Warm regards,
The Marlow Print Billing Team
